memory_bridge: Let the square sun become a three-page calendar: 日曜日 is the Sunday page for On ニチ, 本日 is the TODAY stamp for On ジツ, and the warm daylight itself is native ひ. The shared sun image orders the readings without pretending Sunday, today, and day are the same word.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 日曜日（にちようび）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Circle 日曜日（にちようび） on the sun calendar and read the first character aloud: On ニチ marks Sunday.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 本日（ほんじつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Stamp 本日（ほんじつ） across today’s sunlit page; the final stamp sound is On ジツ, and the word means “today.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 日（ひ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Step out under the pictured sun and call the day itself 日（ひ）; this bare native word gives Kun ひ.
